title: Too lightweight!
text: Too lightweight!. These feel like cheap aluminum pans with enamel over them. They WILL NOT work on induction stove.  The base is so thin it seems to cook everything uneven. I love the color. And all the lids fit snug. A set of bamboo kitchen utensils come with this. A nice touch. Still, these are not the pans for me. I guess I prefer a clad base, enamelware or cast iron.
